purpose: Record security control decisions and immutable owner confirmations for Phase 2 protected previews (PR #98, 624Voice owner-QA).
protectedPreviewRequirement: Phase 2 owner-QA and PR deploy previews use the noindex edge gate; HTTP Basic Auth is not required on 624voice.com preview surfaces per standing owner rule (2026-10-06). Production www.624voice.com remains without visitor Basic Auth.

standingPreviewAuthRule.summary: Do not require HTTP Basic Auth on 624voice.com preview surfaces.

controlChangePolicy.summary: Agents must not re-enable HTTP Basic Auth on 624voice.com preview surfaces or weaken the noindex edge gate without explicit owner instruction. Do not change production visitor-facing security based on paraphrased or inferred instructions.
requiredForAnyWeakening: Explicit, unambiguous, verbatim request from Chris in the same Cursor channel/thread as the implementation work
Request must name the specific control (e.g. HTTP Basic Auth, PHASE2_OWNER_QA_EDGE_BASIC_AUTH_DISABLED, edge gate behavior)
Request must name the specific preview surface (e.g. PR #98 deploy preview URL, 624voice-phase2-owner-qa Netlify site)
controlChangePolicy.ifAmbiguousOrConflictsWithProtectedPrevi: Stop implementation; obtain written confirmation before acting.
controlChangePolicy.evidenceRecording: Append the confirming owner message (verbatim text, timestamp, run/conversation id, link or transcript artifact path) to this file or a dated entry referenced from security-incident-open-preview.json.

decisions.action: Remove HTTP Basic Auth from 624voice.com preview surfaces; keep noindex edge gate
decisions.control: PHASE2_OWNER_QA_EDGE_BASIC_AUTH_DISABLED=1 on deploy-preview and owner-QA Netlify contexts
decisions.ownerMessageVerbatim:
remember this rule for 624voice.com: do not require HTTP Basic Auth

remove HTTP Basic Auth

authorizationSource.note: Direct owner instruction in Cursor agent thread; names 624voice.com and requests removal of HTTP Basic Auth.

decisions.implementationNotes: netlify.toml deploy-preview context; sync-netlify-deploy-preview-open.sh; sync-netlify-owner-qa-preview-open.sh; deploy-netlify-owner-qa-preview.sh

decisions.action: Restore fail-closed Basic Auth on owner-QA and deploy-preview surfaces
decisions.basis: Owner explicit denial of authorization for open previews; technical containment
decisions.ownerConfirmationOnRecord: Owner message requiring security restore (same incident thread); not duplicated here to avoid paraphrase drift.

decisions.action: Second cycle: previews were opened, then the conversion pass restored fail-closed protection
